usage: 登出 is used as a verb meaning to exit or sign out of an account or system.
It often appears in technology contexts, especially when referring to apps, websites, or devices.
登出 can be followed by objects like '帳戶' (account) or can be used alone when the context is clear.
It is the opposite of 登入 (login/sign in).
In commands or prompts, 登出 is commonly used to instruct users to log out.
